basic_info.description: One of the most impressive homes at 1450 Franklin, Residence 501 is a beautifully designed 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom residence with a versatile bonus den. Ideal as a third bedroom, office, guest space, workout room, or all of the above, this flexible area adapts effortlessly to your needs. The open floor plan features a spacious, sunlit living and dining area that flows seamlessly to a private balcony, perfect for enjoying the beautiful city views. Elegant finishes like wide-plank oak wood floors elevate the space, while the chef's kitchen boasts quartz countertops and high-end appliances. With an expansive layout, this residence provides an effortless blend of comfort and sophistication, offering ample space for both everyday living and entertaining. You will love the Northeast residence's largest primary suite, spa-inspired bath and luxurious walk-in closet, Custom window treatments throughout enhance the home's refined aesthetic, offering both style and functionality. Bask in stunning city views and wake up to breathtaking sunrises.The building's amenities incl attended lobby w/ extended hrs, secured parking, bike storage, & a stunning shared rooftop deck w/ firepit, & pano views. With exquisite finishes inside & out, 1450 Franklin sets the standard for modern 5-star city living
